models.family_notes: 4B dense (3.93B) transformer trained from scratch on 13T tokens in six stages, natively to 1M context (256k recommended), on Leonardo (CINECA) with EuroHPC AI Factories compute. Rolling release in three bundles: bundle 1 (2026-10-20) has the base, the SFT checkpoint, 14 intermediate checkpoints, the stage 1 pre-training mix (7.59T of 8.44T released; stack-edu code withheld for attribution) and the training code. Teacher models, the SFT mix and the remaining stage datasets come in bundle 2; the final post-trained model and tech report in November 2026. Data stays documented until most of the 13T tokens are published.

models.family_notes: Hybrid Mamba-3/attention latent MoE (6.77B total, about 1B active) by OVHai LLM (OVH LLM SAS, OVHcloud group). The base was pre-trained from scratch on 12.8T tokens (10.4T pre-training, 2.38T annealing) on 1,024 GH200 GPUs of JUPITER (Jülich, EuroHPC); SFT (162B trained tokens) and a four-stage GRPO RL cascade ran on H100 GPUs of Jean Zay, a smaller DGX cluster (location not stated) and MeluXina. Qwen tokenizer reused (151,936 entries; tokenizer only, attributed in NOTICE). The pre-training and annealing mixes are listed per source with token counts (FineWeb-2, Nemotron-CC v2, Nemotron code and math sets, CCMatrix, ParaCrawl ...); only parts of the public sets were used and the mixed corpus is not published. Three in-house synthetic datasets are public (Math-Enrich-Multilingual, Wikipedia-ActiveReading, ProofWiki-ActiveReading), although the base AI Act summary calls them unpublished. SFT and RL data are given by group; the 27 SFT datasets and 89 RL sources are not listed. One AI Act summary per repo (base, SFT, final). A 256k context extension (Jean Zay) is described but not released.
